:::{#def-joint-entropy}
#### Joint entropy

For $X$ and $Y$ as in @def-joint-surprisal,
their **joint entropy** is the [expectation](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/expectation.html#def-expectation) of their [joint surprisal](#def-joint-surprisal):

$$\entropyf{X, Y} \eqdef \E{\surprisalf{X, Y}}.$$

:::
